d: Anthropic's IPO on November 19 has made most of the company's employees millionaires. Around 5,100 Anthropic employees are now worth at least $1 Million. About 600 of them are now centi-millionaires, which means they have a net worth of at least $100 Million. Firstpost takes a closer look at how so many Anthropic employees have now made a fortune. Hem Kaur Saroya also explains what happened to former employees who left before the IPO. HKS also looks at how the wealth of Dario Amodei and the other Anthropic co-founders has been increased. Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more.
